title: The Bison of the Chalk Parade
description: The prairie town draws its summer parade right on the street. A boy and an older woman watch as their chalk bison takes its first step off the pavement.
alt: A bison made of white, ochre, and turquoise chalk rises from a drawing on the road. A boy and an older woman sit on the curb watching.
pairing: A prairie town’s sidewalk chalk holiday × a bison that steps out of its drawing
